name: optcatalog_process_runtime_instance
description: OptCatalog::ProcessRuntimeInstance casts down from the runtime impact position, handles a selected direct impact, restores projectile active state, and optionally runs the fallback impact probe.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aed00 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRuntimeInstanceStorage*, projectile-node active masking and restore, start point at runtime pos plus 1.0 y, end point lowered by impactProximity * 0.1, closest-hit raycast against g_OptCatalogRuntimeWorld, selected direct hit dispatch, fallback gate on g_OptCatalog_FallbackImpactProbeEnabled and positive impactProximity, BuildImpactHitList with allowOwnerOnlyHit set to 1, runtime position rewrite to the raised start point, and fallback HandleImpactFromRuntimeProbe dispatch with no excluded damage handler.

The native smoke verifies active/raycast flags are restored, the fallback path rewrites the runtime position to the raised impact point, and the corrected fallback hit-list ABI dispatches the target callback.
